creator: colton.deannn
title: 'Six rules' for prompting attributed to Anthropic: give a why, say what not to do, let it act ('when you have enough to act, act'), make it prove it's done, skip narrated reasoning, say less -- then save them in Claude profile preferences

tools.name: Claude Settings > Profile preferences
tools.detail: 'What personal preferences should Claude consider in its responses?' -- where to paste the rules once

claims: 'Anthropic just released six rules on how you should be prompting your AI' (source not shown)
Rule 1: give it a why (who the email is for, what you want)
Rule 2: tell it what not to do, brief it like an intern ('Don't add these features')
Rule 3: let it act -- add 'When you have enough to act, act' to stop clarifying-question stalls
Rule 4: make it prove it's done -- 'Show me the result that proves that it's done. If it's not verified, tell me'
Rule 5: skip the play-by-play -- 'just give me the result', no narrated step-by-step
Rule 6: say less, lead with the outcome; save it once in settings
Claims outputs become 'a million times better'
how_to_steps: State intent and audience in every task prompt
Add explicit exclusions ('don't add these features')
Append 'When you have enough to act, act' to reduce clarifying questions
Append 'Show me the result that proves it's done; if it's not verified, tell me'
Ask for results only, not narrated reasoning
Keep prompts short and outcome-first; paste the rule block once into Claude's Profile preferences
on_screen_only: Title card: 'How to get the BEST AI Results'

Rule cards: 'RULE 1/6 GIVE IT A WHY' (mock Claude input 'Write an email t'), 'RULE 2/6 TELL IT WHAT NOT TO DO' ('Don't add these features' / 'brief it like an intern'), 'RULE 3/6 LET IT ACT' ('When you have enough to act, act.'), 'RULE 3/6 MAKE IT PROVE IT' (mis-numbered on screen; 'Show me the result that proves that it's done' + PROVE IT stamp), 'RULE 4/6 SKIP THE PLAY-BY-PLAY' (Thinking... narrating every step: Step 1/2/3), 'RULE 5/6 SAY LESS' (28 words counter), 'RULE 6/6 SAVE IT ONCE' (Settings > Profile)
End card: 'COMMENT CLAUDE -- I'll DM you all 6 rules + the copy-paste block'
cta: Comment 'CLAUDE' for the six rules and a copy-paste settings block

relevance.why: Generic prompting hygiene Haji already practices; the 'prove it's done' and 'when you have enough to act, act' lines are the only ones worth lifting into CLAUDE.md, and the liked set already has verification-skill content.

implement_score.why: Two one-line additions to CLAUDE.md / global prefs: 'when you have enough context, act without asking' and 'show verified evidence before claiming done'. Five minutes; the rest is already covered.

verify: Did Anthropic actually publish 'six rules'? This looks like a creator's paraphrase of Anthropic prompting docs / the Claude 5 system-prompt philosophy, not an official list
'Skip the play-by-play' conflicts with wanting reasoning on hard tasks -- apply selectively

gap.what: duplicate of liked content: liked set already has Anthropic's Claude 5 prompt-philosophy video, Minto-style prompting, and verification skills; attribution to Anthropic is unverified.
